about: Lines for the @spookyparticles account on X, posted top first, one a day at most. Only the Spooky session adds a line, after checking it against what is live, and it records when and against what. A line already posted is never posted again.

lines.text: When a deploy fails, the Spooky Particles alert names the cause from a build log line, for Vercel and GitHub Actions.
lines.source: https://spookyparticles.com/llms.txt, What it does today: Failed deploys

lines.text: Spooky Particles watches the cron jobs on your Vercel projects with no code change, and alerts you when a run is missed, errors, or comes back.
lines.source: https://spookyparticles.com/llms.txt, What it does today: Vercel cron jobs (path crons only)

lines.text: Spooky Particles warns you up to 30 days before a Vercel Node.js runtime is retired or a domain bought through Vercel expires.
lines.source: https://spookyparticles.com/llms.txt, What it does today: runtime and domain expiry notices
